alex: kicking off a quick smoke sweep for quantized kernels — FP8 / INT8 / 4-bit. want a reproducible checklist so results aren't noisy.
kai: +1. what are the invariants we want? exact prompt set, tokenization, hvd/pinning, power caps?
maria: minimally: same seed, same tokenizer/version, fixed batch-size distribution (not just avg), and preheat policy for KV cache.
sam: can we add a 'cold-kv vs hot-kv' split? i.e., measure 1) first request after model load 2) steady-state after N tokens with prefix reuse
alex: yes — plan: three phases per run: cold (no cache), warmup (single long prefix 512 tokens), steady (60s steady traffic). record p95/p99 and throughput.
jen: also capture kernel selection trace (which kernel path was chosen per layer). that helps explain weird regressions we saw last week.
perf-bot: scheduling bench job template queued: run-quant-sweep-1853456789, tracker: https://ci.internal/runs/1853456789
alex: putting a short command snippet folks can use locally:

```
./bench_run --model /models/ggml-quant --tokens 1024 --batch-dist "[1,2,4,8]" \
  --tokenizer=v2 --kv-preheat=512 --power=200 --log-kernels > run.log
```

kai: note on power: use fixed GPU power limit (e.g., 200W) and report the power telemetry. some kernels look faster but only when the GPU is allowed extra headroom.
maria: on calibration: run calibration on the same dataset used for eval, but keep a separate 'neutral' calibration set to check overfitting to the calibration distribution.
sam: quick profiling snippet from yesterday (toy run):
- FP8: steady throughput 210 t/s, p95 42ms
- INT8: steady throughput 195 t/s, p95 45ms
- 4-bit: steady throughput 230 t/s, p95 60ms
notes: 4-bit had higher throughput but worse p95 — tail latency impact from emulated ops.
jen: interesting — can you also pull KV cache hit ratio and per-layer matmul times? I suspect layer 10-20 kernel fallback caused the tail.
alex: yes. we'll ingest per-layer timings + kernel-id map. action items:
- alex: produce bench harness with kernel logging (ETA EOD)
- kai: add cold/warm/steady phases to orchestration and power control (ETA tomorrow)
- maria: prepare calibration vs neutral cal set and tokenizer lockfile (ETA EOD)
- sam: run 3 full sweeps and upload run logs (ETA 48h)
- jen: write short postmortem template to capture regressions and mitigation steps (ETA 48h)

maria: quick gotcha: tokenization differences can shift seq-length distribution; please pin tokenizer commit and show seq-length histogram in artifacts.
alex: agreed — harness will emit token-length histogram + percentiles.
perf-bot: run-quant-sweep-1853456789 started  (job 4827). logs: https://ci.internal/logs/4827
kai: if anyone sees >10% perf delta vs baseline, add a short reproduction with `--trace-kernel` enabled and file a regression ticket.
jen: also mention model-seed in the artifacts, we had one run where weight ordering changed because of an upstream model rebuild.
sam: thumbs up. will share first sweep results in this thread when done. :+1:
alex: thanks everyone. goal is an internal playbook we can re-run before any quant rollout to catch obvious regressions. keep notes in the job artifacts and reference this thread for decisions.
